source_refs.note: Roman Urdu guide to the Chapter 6 exercise (PDF 91-92) with the MCQ answers from the text beside the printed key.

blocks.text: Exercise mein 10 MCQs, 10 short questions aur 8 long questions hain. Sawal English tab mein kitab ki tarah diye gaye hain. Neeche ki table har MCQ ka jawab chapter ke text se, us ke saath kitab ki answer key (kitab ka safha 88) aur woh topic batati hai jahan jawab samjhaya gaya hai. Pehle khud hal karein, phir milayein.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key ke tamam 10 jawab (B, B, C, B, C, C, B, C, B, B) chapter ke text se milte hain. MCQ 5 aur 6 ka option "Rule-based learning" chapter mein bayan nahi hua; dekhiye 6.4 ka Roman Urdu note.

items: Data science kya hai? (jawab: 6.1)
Data ki do bari qismein kaun si hain? (jawab: 6.2)
Structured aur unstructured data mein kya farq hai? (jawab: 6.2)
Data jama karne ke do aam tareeqe batayein. (jawab: 6.2)
Machine learning kya hai? (jawab: 6.3)
Supervised learning kya hai? (jawab: 6.4)
Machine learning mein features chunne ka maqsad kya hai? (jawab: 6.6)
Model mein accuracy kya napti hai? (jawab: 6.7)
Prediction aur causality mein kya farq hai? (jawab: 6.9)
Machine learning ka koi ek tool batayein. (jawab: 6.10)
Data science ka tasawwur samjhayein aur aaj ki applications mein is ki ahmiyat bayan karein. (jawab: 6.1)
Data ki qismein bayan karein aur data ke sources aur jama karne ke tareeqe samjhayein. (jawab: 6.2)
Machine learning ka tasawwur aur is ke mechanisms: supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement aur rule-based learning. (jawab: 6.3 aur 6.4; rule-based ka note 6.4 ke Roman Urdu mein)
Healthcare, business, education aur rozmarra zindagi mein machine learning ke istemal. (jawab: 6.5)
Machine learning model banane ke qadam: feature selection, feature engineering aur train-test split. (jawab: 6.6)
Model evaluation ke tareeqe; accuracy, precision, recall aur F1-score. (jawab: 6.7)
Machine learning mein validation, aur parameter tuning se models ki behtari. (jawab: 6.8)
Predictive modeling aur causality, aur asal zindagi mein model ke nataij samajhne (interpretation) ki ahmiyat. (jawab: 6.9)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Long Question 8 "model interpretation" (model ke nataij ka matlab samajhna) poochta hai; chapter is lafz ko istemal nahi karta, magar 6.9 ka prediction aur causation ka farq isi ka jawab hai: andaza kya batata hai aur kya nahi batata.

Har short aur long question ka jawab us ke topic ke Roman Urdu lesson mein hai.
